Get EASL Player Box Score

Source: R/easl.R
easl_player_box.Rd

Player box score of a finished game, one row per rostered player (non-players have null counting stats).

Endpoint: GET https://easl.joshricha.com/api/v1/matches/{fixture_id}/boxscore

Usage

easl_player_box(fixture_id)

Arguments

fixture_id

(required) DataCore fixture (game) UUID v1, e.g. '10af8fd4-106e-11f1-960b-5798087c7aa3' (the 2025-26 EASL Championship): the 'id' of easl_schedule rows. Only finished (CONFIRMED) games are served; a malformed id is hoopR_bad_request.

Value

A hoopR_data tibble: Player box score of a finished game, one row per rostered player (non-players have null counting stats). An empty answer raises hoopR_no_data; the columns are always these, in this order (sdv-py easl_player_box):

col_nametypedescription
fixture_idcharacterDataCore fixture (game) UUID v1 of the box row.
team_idcharacterThe player's team: DataCore team (entity) UUID v1 (the wire's entityId).
team_namecharacterThe player's team display name, joined from the body's teams array.
team_name_nativecharacterThe player's team name in native script, joined from the body's teams array; blank for most clubs.
player_idcharacterplayerId: DataCore person UUID v1 (key space: EASL persons, the same id as the box score's personId; joins /players, leaders and play-by-play players). Not a team id.
player_namecharacterPlayer display name in 'FAMILY Given' form with the family name upper-cased (OSAKABE Taiki), in Latin script. Absent on some rows.
player_name_latincharacterAlternative name: equal to nameFullLocal for 257 of 552 players, otherwise null; never non-Latin in the observed data. Absent on some rows.
bibcharacterJersey number as a string ('00' and '0' are distinct).
positioncharacterPlaying position: G, F, C, PG, SG, SF, PF or GF; null on some rows.
starterlogicalTrue for a starter (five per team).
is_playerlogicalTrue on every row (team officials are never listed).
is_team_officiallogicalFalse on every row.
playedlogicalTrue when the player has playing time (minutes present); False for the rostered players who did not play (their counting stats are null).
minutes_playeddoublePlaying time in minutes (decimal), parsed from the ISO 8601 minutes statistic (PT35M11S = 35.1833).
assistsintegerAssists: passes that directly lead to a made field goal. Null on some rows.
assists_defensiveintegerDefensive assists (DataCore column; meaning unverified). Null on some rows.
assists_turnover_ratiodoubleAssists divided by turnovers (a ratio, not a percentage). Null on some rows.
blocksintegerShots blocked (made by this player or team). Null on some rows.
blocks_receivedintegerThe team's or player's own shots that were blocked by an opponent. Null on some rows.
double_doubleintegerDouble-double flag: 1 when exactly two of points, rebounds, assists, steals, blocks reached 10 in the game, else 0 (a triple-double is counted in tripleDouble instead). In a season line it is a count of such games.
dunksintegerDunks made. Null on some rows.
efficiencyintegerNBA-style efficiency: points + rebounds + assists + steals + blocks - missed field goals - missed free throws - turnovers (verified on all 2,143 played player-games).
efficiency_customintegerCustom efficiency slot (DataCore column; meaning unverified). Null on some rows.
field_goals_attemptedintegerField goals attempted (2- and 3-point shots; free throws excluded). Null on some rows.
field_goals_effective_percentagedoubleEffective field-goal percentage on a 0-100 scale: (FGM + 0.5 x 3PM) / FGA x 100; can exceed 100 on small samples. Null on some rows.
field_goals_madeintegerField goals made (2- and 3-point shots). Null on some rows.
field_goals_percentagedoubleField-goal percentage on a 0-100 scale (made / attempted x 100). Null on some rows.
fouls_coach_disqualifyingintegerDisqualifying fouls on the coach. Null on some rows.
fouls_coach_technicalintegerTechnical fouls on the coach. Null on some rows.
fouls_disqualifyingintegerDisqualifying fouls. Null on some rows.
fouls_disruptiveintegerDisruptive fouls (DataCore column; filled from 2026-27). Null on some rows.
fouls_drawnintegerFouls drawn (committed against this player or team by an opponent). Null on some rows.
fouls_flagrantintegerFlagrant fouls (DataCore column; filled from 2026-27). Null on some rows.
fouls_offensiveintegerOffensive fouls committed. Counted separately from foulsPersonal. Null on some rows.
fouls_personalintegerPersonal fouls committed (offensive, technical and unsportsmanlike fouls are separate columns). Null on some rows.
fouls_technicalintegerTechnical fouls committed by the player or team. Null on some rows.
fouls_technical_cat1integerTechnical fouls of category 1 (DataCore column; filled from 2026-27). Null on some rows.
fouls_technical_cat2integerTechnical fouls of category 2 (DataCore column; filled from 2026-27). Null on some rows.
fouls_totalintegerFouls charged in total: personal + technical + unsportsmanlike + offensive (matches 2,142 of 2,143 played player-games; the exception is unexplained).
fouls_unsportsmanlikeintegerUnsportsmanlike fouls committed. Null on some rows.
free_throws_attemptedintegerFree throws attempted. Null on some rows.
free_throws_madeintegerFree throws made: a game count on the box-score and team-total routes, a season total on the season statistics routes.
free_throws_percentagedoubleFree-throw percentage on a 0-100 scale. Null on some rows.
index_of_successintegerIndex of success: efficiency + fouls drawn - personal fouls - technical fouls - blocks received (verified on all 2,143 played player-games). It differs from pir only in which fouls it subtracts.
max_assistsintegerHighest assists in a single game: in a game row it equals assists; in a season line it is the best game. Null on some rows.
max_free_throws_madeintegerHighest free throws made in a single game (equals freeThrowsMade in a game row).
max_pointsintegerHighest points in a single game (equals points in a game row).
max_points_four_madeintegerHighest 4-point shots made in a game (DataCore column; EASL has no 4-point line; filled from 2026-27). Null on some rows.
max_points_three_madeintegerHighest 3-pointers made in a single game. Null on some rows.
max_points_two_madeintegerHighest 2-pointers made in a single game. Null on some rows.
max_reboundsintegerHighest rebounds in a single game. Null on some rows.
max_rebounds_defensiveintegerHighest defensive rebounds in a single game. Null on some rows.
max_rebounds_offensiveintegerHighest offensive rebounds in a single game. Null on some rows.
max_stealsintegerHighest steals in a single game. Null on some rows.
minusintegerPoints the opponents scored while the player was on the court. Null on some rows.
minutescharacterPlaying time as an ISO 8601 duration PT{m}M{s}S with the minutes NOT wrapped at 60 (PT27M53S; a team's is the sum of its players', PT200M for a 40-minute game, PT250M with one overtime). Null on some rows.
pirintegerPerformance index rating: efficiency + fouls drawn - total fouls - blocks received (verified on all 2,143 played player-games).
plusintegerPoints the player's team scored while he was on the court. Null on some rows.
plus_minusintegerplus - minus: the team's point margin while the player was on the court. Null on some rows.
pointsintegerPoints scored: a game count on the box-score and team-total routes, a season total on the season statistics routes.
points_fast_breakintegerPoints scored on fast breaks. Null on some rows.
points_fast_break_attemptedintegerFast-break field goals attempted. Null on some rows.
points_fast_break_madeintegerFast-break field goals made. Null on some rows.
points_four_attemptedinteger4-point shots attempted (DataCore column; EASL has no 4-point line; filled from 2026-27). Null on some rows.
points_four_madeinteger4-point shots made (see pointsFourAttempted). Null on some rows.
points_four_percentagedoubleNot yet populated upstream: null in every full body observed (2026-10-12), so its meaning is unverified; the 2026-27 bodies start filling some of these columns, so it is typed from its family (Float64).
points_from_turnoverintegerPoints scored off opponent turnovers. Null on some rows.
points_in_the_paintintegerPoints scored in the paint. Null on some rows.
points_in_the_paint_attemptedintegerField goals attempted in the paint. Null on some rows.
points_in_the_paint_madeintegerField goals made in the paint. Null on some rows.
points_second_chanceintegerPoints scored on second-chance possessions (after an offensive rebound). Null on some rows.
points_second_chance_attemptedintegerSecond-chance field goals attempted. Null on some rows.
points_second_chance_madeintegerSecond-chance field goals made. Null on some rows.
points_three_attemptedinteger3-point field goals attempted. Null on some rows.
points_three_madeinteger3-point field goals made. Null on some rows.
points_three_percentagedouble3-point percentage on a 0-100 scale. Null on some rows.
points_two_attemptedinteger2-point field goals attempted. Null on some rows.
points_two_madeinteger2-point field goals made. Null on some rows.
points_two_percentagedouble2-point percentage on a 0-100 scale. Null on some rows.
power_play_pointsintegerPower-play points (an ice-hockey column; meaning in basketball unverified). Null on some rows.
power_play_points_awardedintegerPower-play points awarded (an ice-hockey column; meaning in basketball unverified). Null on some rows.
reboundsintegerTotal rebounds: offensive + defensive. Team's totals include team rebounds. Null on some rows.
rebounds_defensiveintegerDefensive rebounds. Null on some rows.
rebounds_defensive_percentagedoubleShare of available defensive rebounds taken while on the court, on a 0-100 scale; values above 100 (up to 108.9) occur, so the definition is unverified. Null on some rows.
rebounds_offensiveintegerOffensive rebounds. Null on some rows.
rebounds_offensive_percentagedoubleShare of available offensive rebounds taken while on the court, 0-100 scale (up to 91.4 observed); definition unverified. Null on some rows.
rebounds_percentagedoubleShare of all available rebounds taken while on the court, 0-100 scale; definition unverified. Null on some rows.
stealsintegerSteals. Null on some rows.
triple_doubleintegerTriple-double flag: 1 when three or more of points, rebounds, assists, steals, blocks reached 10, else 0.
true_shooting_attemptsdoubleNot yet populated upstream: null in every full body observed (2026-10-12), so its meaning is unverified; the 2026-27 bodies start filling some of these columns, so it is typed from its family (Float64).
true_shooting_percentagedoubleNot yet populated upstream: null in every full body observed (2026-10-12), so its meaning is unverified; the 2026-27 bodies start filling some of these columns, so it is typed from its family (Float64).
turnoversintegerTurnovers committed by players. Null on some rows.
turnovers_percentagedoubleNot yet populated upstream: null in every full body observed (2026-10-12), so its meaning is unverified; the 2026-27 bodies start filling some of these columns, so it is typed from its family (Float64).
usage_ratedoubleUsage rate on a 0-100 scale: share of the team's possessions used while on the court (up to 136 observed); definition unverified. Null on some rows.

Details

  • WARNING: UNOFFICIAL THIRD-PARTY INTERMEDIARY. These wrappers read easl.joshricha.com/api/v1, an Express server run by an individual. It is not EASL's and not Sportradar's: it mirrors Sportradar DataCore (organisation b1e0z) into SQLite and serves it keyless, and it can change or vanish without notice. Its routes, field names (steak, facebook_username) and sync freshness are the proxy author's. A first-party DataCore feed needs credentials this package does not have. The host serves no robots.txt (404) and states no terms; the runtime waits at least 1 s before every request, retries included, and honours Retry-After. Payloads are not redistributed as release assets.

  • Seasons are END years (2026 = EASL 25-26). The server's season key is the START year; the runtime reads the season list, maps the END year to the DataCore seasonId and defaults to the ACTIVE season. Four editions exist (2023-24 to 2026-27). The server defaults to the active season on /matches, /standings and /leaders; the runtime always sends the resolved seasonId. A season is two calendar years: group by season_id, not by the year of the tip-off.

  • Finished games only: the game routes first read the fixture and refuse (hoopR_asset_fetch) one that is not CONFIRMED with two scores, a box score whose player points do not add up to the score (the server serves one-team, four-row boxes for some games), a play-by-play that does not end on the final score in its highest period (4 or more, and the last period of the period table), and team totals that disagree with the score. For the ACTIVE season's fixture lists the runtime reads /health: a server clock more than a day from yours, or a game still SCHEDULED more than a day after its tip-off, means the mirror has stalled (hoopR_asset_fetch). That proves the mirror kept up with the games played, not that a game is final upstream.

  • Ids: every DataCore id is a UUID v1 string. team_id = entityId, player_id = personId; fixture_number (YYSSNNN) is null on every 2023-24 fixture; *_row_id columns are the sync server's own integers, not DataCore ids. The fixture's competitors come in arbitrary order: read home_* / away_*, which the parsers take from isHome.

  • No shot x/y, no game clock and no lineups exist on this server. The play-by-play text always says 'missed' for field goals and 'Free throw K of M made' for free throws, made or not: use points_scored (the change of the event team's running score), which lags on a minority of events. 301 of 2,444 sampled box rows are players who did not play (null minutes and counting stats; points are 0); player_box.played tells them apart. easl_player_stats ignores a season filter: it is the career line over every season. Names: nameFullLocal is the English display name and nameFullLatin the native-script name, so the columns are name and name_native.

  • Errors are classed conditions, all inheriting hoopR_error: hoopR_no_data (HTTP 404, an empty list or leaders object, a team or player without games), hoopR_bad_request (a malformed id, or a season that is not one of the server's END years, raised before the request that would use it) and hoopR_asset_fetch (any other failure: any non-2xx, including the server's HTTP 400 / 422 and the HTTP 500 it answers for an unknown fixture, which is not retried; an error envelope; a game that is not finished or whose box score or play-by-play is incomplete; a stalled sync on the active season; a body for another game, season, team or player than the one asked for). Wrappers raise; they never warn and return an empty frame.
